name: mcnamee-claude-skills
description: Single-file MCP servers for working with Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Confluence, Jira, PDFs and a local RAG knowledge base. Each plugin bundles one server with its matching skill, so it installs and updates as one unit - including fully offline.

plugins.name: word
plugins.description: Read, edit and create Word .docx files - including Word tracked changes, native styles and filling out templates.

plugins.name: powerpoint
plugins.description: Build PowerPoint decks that inherit your own template's layouts and theme, and audit them against Guy Kawasaki's 10/20/30 rule.

plugins.name: excel
plugins.description: Read and analyse Excel workbooks - sheets, Tables by name and pivot tables - by parsing .xlsx directly. Also writes cells and Table rows and creates real PivotTables through the installed Excel (Windows, pywin32).

plugins.name: outlook
plugins.description: Read local classic Outlook mail and calendar via COM, schedule a meeting (fuzzy directory search, free/busy, and an unsent draft you send yourself), and print a day as a PDF planner in your own category colours. Windows only; requires pywin32.

plugins.name: confluence
plugins.description: Search and read Confluence pages across one or two instances, with macro content (task reports, page properties, panels, inline tasks) included; edit the tables on a page in place (even inside table filter or column macros), and create, update and append to pages, and upload attachments (replacing an image on a page); download page attachments into the folder the matching plugin reads; save a page to the knowledge base when you ask - writing only when switched on.

plugins.name: jira
plugins.description: Query Jira issues, sprints and projects, and - when switched on - create, edit, comment on and transition issues (Jira Data Center v2 REST API).

plugins.name: knowledge-base
plugins.description: True RAG over your own Markdown docs: a local ChromaDB vector index plus your embeddings API. Captures new notes back into it. Requires chromadb.

plugins.name: pdf-to-md
plugins.description: Convert PDFs to Markdown with tables preserved, for feeding a local knowledge base. Requires pymupdf.
